How a report gets signed
01
Practice lead drafts
The named practice lead for your service line walks the plant, captures evidence, models the system, and drafts the report. The draft carries the lead's name from page one.
›
02
Principal reviewer cross-checks
An independent principal reviewer cross-checks the model, the assumptions, the calculation, and the recommendation. Every page. Every number. Nothing waved through.
›
03
Chairman or CEO countersigns
The Chairman () or the CEO () countersigns with their personal credentials. The signature is the contract. The name is the audit trail. The accountability is personal.
